name: The Ritz-Carlton, St. Thomas
description: Escape to an island oasis surrounded by crystal blue waters, white sand and lush tropical greenery at our St. Thomas extended-stay. A breathtaking 30 acre, oceanfront luxury St. Thomas resort. The Ritz-Carlton, St. Thomas is a Caribbean marvel styled after traditional island architecture, but richly updated with all of the contemporary comforts for which the resorts of The Ritz-Carlton are known.

name: Buoy Haus Beach Resort St. Thomas, Autograph Colle
description: Against a stunning backdrop of tropic blue, you are immersed in a dreamy, world-class resort experience at our St. Thomas hotel. One that draws inspiration from the abundance and diversity of the natural elements and life that surrounds us. Within this thriving ecosystem, we distill the very best of our island environment and seamlessly translate it to you; creating an entirely unique travel experience that’s as richly colorful and lively as the coral reefs that ring these islands when staying at our St. Thomas oceanfront hotel. Guests at Buoy Haus Beach Resort St. Thomas or The Westin Beach Resort & Spa are offered the convenience of accessing The Westin Beach Resort & Spa’s amenities.

name: The Westin St. Thomas Beach Resort & Spa
description: Take time to pamper yourself with a visit to the full-service spa. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 3 outdoor swimming pools, a health club, and a sauna. This resort also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and free babysitting. Enjoy Mediterranean cuisine at Luna Mar, one of the resort's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink at the beach bar, the poolside bar, or one of 2 bars/lounges. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in St. Thomas? This resort has 9500 square feet (883 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 14 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge during limited hours.

description: Daily Mandatory Charge includes: Economic Recovery Fee. Enjoy the view from our harbor-front hotel, surrounded by shopping, restaurants, and nightlife. Havensight Mall is across the street, and attractions in Charlotte Amalie are within 10 minutes. Magens Bay Beach is a 20-minute drive, and Virgin Islands National Park is an hour from our hotel. We offer a full bar and lounge overlooking the water.

name: Limetree Beach Resort by Club Wyndham
description: Nestled on a secluded beach on the southern end of St. Thomas, this resort offers a quiet escape on 24 acres of beachfront property. Guests can relax by the outdoor pool, which features a swim-up bar, or enjoy the convenience of direct beach access. The resort provides family-friendly accommodation and features an on-site restaurant and bar. Rooms range from studios to one-bedroom suites, some of which are individually decorated and open onto furnished balconies or patios. In-room amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, air conditioning, a microwave, and a refrigerator. For recreation, the property includes a tennis court and pickleball facilities. Free self-parking is available for guests.

name: Club Wyndham Elysian Beach Resort
description: Enjoy a relaxing stay at Club Wyndham Elysian Beach Resort in St. Thomas, situated on the beach with stunning views of Cowpet Bay. Take a dip in the outdoor pool, unwind in the hot tub, or play a game on the tennis court. The resort offers two on-site restaurants, a bar/lounge, and a poolside bar for your dining and entertainment needs. Each of the 69 guestrooms features a kitchenette, private furnished balcony, and a 55-inch flat-screen TV. Complimentary Wi-Fi, safes, and microwaves are also provided. Conveniently located near popular attractions such as Sapphire Beach and Secret Harbour Beach, and a short drive from the airport.

name: Margaritaville Vacation Club by Wyndham-St. Thomas
description: It's five o'clock somewhere! So kick off your flip flops, pick up a cold drink, and stay for a while at the US Virgin Islands. Relax on the soft white sands of Water Bay, situated on the eastern side of the island. Margaritaville Vacation Club by Wyndham-St. Thomas isn't just an incredible new beach resort for Jimmy Buffett Parrotheads - it's also your own personal Margaritaville, famous for picture-perfect beaches, exceptional shopping and a laid-back atmosphere that takes all your worries away.

name: Point Pleasant Resort
description: Situated on the beautiful island of St. Thomas, this comfortable hotel offers the perfect base for exploring this stunning destination. Just a short 5-minute drive from Red Hook harbor and steps from Coki Beach and Coral World Ocean Park, it's an ideal choice for families. The hotel provides easy access to numerous picturesque beaches and a wide array of activities. Its spacious villas are tastefully decorated and feature balconies with breathtaking ocean views. Each villa is fully equipped with modern amenities, including air conditioning and a full kitchen for convenient self-catering. Guests can also enjoy refreshing drinks at the beachfront bar and restaurant or take a dip in one of the three pools.

name: Secret Harbour Beach Resort
description: Don't miss out on the many recreational opportunities, including outdoor tennis courts, an outdoor pool, and a fitness center. This aparthotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Satisfy your appetite at Sunset Grille, one of the aparthotel's 2 restaurants. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the beach bar. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 8 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Limited parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 70 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring kitchens with refrigerators and ovens. Rooms have private furnished balconies or patios. Wired and wireless internet access is complimentary, and flat-screen televisions with cable programming provide entertainment. Conveniences include safes and microwaves, and housekeeping is provided daily.

name: Emerald Beach Resort
description: This beachfront resort has everything guests need for a relaxing holiday in the tropics, including a great location in St. Thomas, an island in the Caribbean Sea. Close to Cyril E. King Airport, travellers will find a wide choice of watersports right outside the doors of the hotel, including jet skiing, scuba diving, snorkelling or paddle boating. Beaches like Lindbergh Bay, located in the surrounding area, are ideal for sun bathing and romantic strolls. Nearby entertainment options include Mahogany Run Golf Course, situated just a 20-minute driving distance away. The spacious and comfortable rooms feature a beautiful tropical design and come fully-equipped to provide a comfortable home away from home. The onsite facilities and services include a magnificent outdoor pool with waterfall as well as a choice of dining options such as a beachfront restaurant serving American and authentic Caribbean cuisines.

name: Bolongo Bay Beach Resort
description: Built in 1974, this fun, friendly beach resort exudes a vibrant Caribbean atmosphere with attentive staff. Nestled along the 300-meter crescent of Bolongo Bay's palm-lined white sand beach and opal-blue ocean, it offers picturesque views. As one of St. Thomas' few beachfront resorts overlooking the Caribbean Sea, it's ideal for travelers seeking recreation and relaxation. Complimentary kayaks, stand-up paddleboards, Hobie Cat sailboats, and snorkel gear are available, along with various beach activities. For relaxation, guests can unwind on loungers around the outdoor swimming pool and enjoy a refreshing cocktail from the swim-up bar.

name: Sapphire Beach Resort Condominium
description: The hotel is located 1. 6 km from the town of Red Hook on the eastern tip of the island of Saint Thomas. Red Hook features many conveniences and numerous grocers, along with many additional dining options. The ferry service to San Juan and the Virgin Islands is near the hotel, which is located on one of the most beautiful beaches in the Caribbean. Renovated in 2010, the air-conditioned apartment hotel offers a lobby, safe and parking. There are 79 suites on offer. All rooms have individually regulated air conditioning, a safe, cable television, a ceiling fan and telephones. The en suite bathrooms are fitted with a shower, bath and hairdryer. The suites are furnished with king-size beds. Further standard amenities include Internet access, an ironing set, and a balcony or terrace. The kitchens feature a fridge, cooker, microwave, and tea and coffee making facilities. Guests may take an invigorating dip in the outdoor swimming pool. Refreshments are served at the poolside snack bar. Sun loungers are laid out at the hotel and on the sandy beach for use. Diving, windsurfing and sailing are available for additional fees. Canoeing, tennis and beach volleyball are further leisure options provided. A golf course is roughly a 15-minute drive away.

name: The Westin St. John Resort Villas
description: Revive your spirit on the shores of St. John at The Westin St. John Resort Villas, a premium vacation ownership resort nestled in the U.S. Virgin Islands. Discover a St. John vacation experience with white-sand beaches just steps or minutes away. After snorkeling, hiking, or sightseeing, return to unwind in our quarter-acre pool, participate in family-friendly resort activities, or indulge at our on-site restaurants. Choose from a studio, one- or two-bedroom townhouse, or two-, or three-bedroom villa rentals, all offering thoughtful amenities like the Westin Heavenly® Bed. For elevated comfort, our largest accommodations include private pools and up to 2,850 square feet of living space for eight guests, plus full kitchens, washers/dryers, and stunning views from furnished balconies or patios. Whether you're traveling with friends or family, your ideal tropical retreat awaits at our St. John resort.
